title: Chicago-based data analytics company Ocient raised a $100M Series C co-led by Boka Capital and OCA Ventures to grow its agentic AI analytics business (Paul Gillin/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Paul Gillin / SiliconANGLE: Chicago-based data analytics company Ocient raised a $100M Series C co-led by Boka Capital and OCA Ventures to grow its agentic AI analytics business — Ocient Inc., the maker of a speedy data analytics platform, today said it has raised $100 million in a Series C funding to expand …
